notes: CEILING: the render model has no single ceiling height. Kitchen 2.67, dining wall 2.60, TV-wall cabinet tops 2.52, living-room wall junction 2.49 (above the windows, where the double LED rectangle is). So the living part probably has a lower (dropped) ceiling of about 2.49, and the dining/kitchen part about 2.60-2.67; a 5-8 cm fit bias is possible. Owner: 2.40 everywhere. Heights here are in the render-model scale; to adopt 2.40 keep absolute furniture heights (worktop 0.90, island 0.77, table 0.74, TV unit 0.25-0.68, sills 0.99) and re-anchor ceiling-hung items, or scale every y by 2.40/2.60 = 0.923. Window heads (2.36) and the balcony-door head (2.42) do not fit under 2.40 with their boxes, so they need a decision.

LENSES: two focal lengths fit, lens A 1973 px (hfov 65.9, vfov 51.9 deg) for 13 renders and lens B 2481 px (hfov 54.6, vfov 42.3 deg) for p09, p11, p12, p14 (vanishing points: p04, p06, p08 give 2026-2049 px, p11, p12, p14 give 2497-2511 px). In near-frontal views (p03, p05, p07, p10, p13, p15, p17) the lens is weakly determined and A was kept; for p17 the living drum size prefers B (camera then at 8.87, 2.06, -0.85) but the LED rectangle prefers A.

CAMERA ACCURACY: fit rms 0.4-3.5 px for 11 renders; p03 4.7, p05 6.4, p07 6.4, p14 5.7, p15 4.8, p16 5.7 px because plan positions and renders disagree by 3-5 cm in places (kitchen columns in p05/p07, window reveals in p03). Expect +-10 cm and +-0.5 deg for those six. p15 has no height reference of its own: its camera height assumes its top-wall ceiling junction equals the right-wall one (2.49). Cameras p02, p04, p10, p11, p12, p14, p16 are outside the room (see near_clip_m); p11 is above the ceiling.

OPENINGS: the only windows are the two on the right wall (single-sash, sill 0.99, frame 1.04-2.15, shutter box to 2.36) and the balcony door on the bottom wall (x 9.96-10.64, head 2.42). Plan items A-E on the top/left wall are walnut panels, a mirror and a slatted panel, not windows; D is not a radiator.

The island top (0.77) is 13 cm lower than the kitchen worktop (0.90): a table-height island (cross-checked in p04, p05, p10 and against the floor corner in p14, which wants about 3 cm more). Bar-stool seats about 0.64.
Dining table: owner rule (labels) x 4.41-6.31; the render model and drawing use x 4.382-6.311.

Uncertain: living drum z (1.5-2.1), divider shelf heights (+-10 cm), sofa/armchair/coffee table/rug extents (+-10-15 cm), the curtain track (not visible), the exact hob and sink positions (hob on the bottom run left of the oven column, sink in the left run near the corner), the island dining-side overhang (about 0.25). Only one round ceiling light is visible in the kitchen; docs/room-notes.md says lights (plural).
Colours are rendered pixel values; see colours._how_to_read. Materials shared with other rooms (walnut, greige, stone, wood floor) should use one base colour across rooms.
